scenes.prompt: A small vermilion red paper boat carries one bright golden lantern across an immense midnight-blue ocean. The boat sits clearly near the center-left, its folded red silhouette reflected below. Towering dark teal waves curve like the pages of a vast open book around it. Far to the right, a warm amber doorway shines in an enormous pearly spiral shell rising from the water. The tiny boat is dwarfed by the waves and shell, but its red color and lantern are clearly visible. A thin white moon hangs above the distant shell.
